notes.title: Hotfixes & Greed Boss Awaits (EA v1.0.11)
notes.content:
Hey Sanctum heroes,
We’ve been busy sweeping up loose code, disciplining unruly stairs, and banishing some particularly sneaky bugs back to whatever pit they crawled from. Your path through hell should now be smoother, sassier, and a little less “why won’t this work?”

Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] Fixed some very suspicious stairs. They used to demand a little hop for no reason! Turns out their collision boxes went wheeee instead of staying put. They now behave like normal, polite stairs.
[*] Ground collisions got a touch-up too, so you shouldn’t be tripping into invisible holes anymore.
[*] Loudmouth’s (the minigun) sound bug fixed. It used to drown out every other sound in the game with its endless BRRRRRRRRT, turning every run into a one-weapon concert. You can now hear the rest of hell again 🔥
[*] Third theme is back in action! We had to politely yeet the wave system (some developery black magic went slightly… wrong). Bug squashed, treasure’s piled up, and the Boss of Greed is waiting for you.
[/list]
Thanks to everyone for playing, breaking, and telling us what broke. You’re the reason these patch notes exist and we appreciate it ❤️

notes.title: Performance Patch – Enemy Optimization Boost (v0.0.108)
notes.content:
We’ve just shipped a focused performance update to make your runs smoother and more stable, especially during chaotic encounters. Here’s what’s new:

[b]Enemy Cost Optimization[/b]
Enemies have been rebalanced under the hood to be far more GPU-friendly. Their processing “cost” has been reduced to roughly 25% of what it was.
This means your system can now handle more enemies on screen without breaking a sweat. You should notice significant FPS improvements, especially during larger waves and intense fights.

[b]Improved Spawn Behavior[/b]
Enemies in large rooms no longer spawn all at once. Instead, they now appear in staggered waves, which reduces sudden performance spikes and makes fights feel more dynamic.
This should further improve FPS in big areas and keep the chaos fun, not choppy.

These changes don’t affect gameplay balance, just performance. Let us know how it runs on your machine!

notes.title: Major FPS Fixes, Early Access Banner, and the Weapon Apocalypse 🔥 (v0.0.107)
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We've got a meaty update today, including:  [/p][list][*][p]The Early Access banner finally showing up on the store page [/p][/*][*][p]A round of important hotfixes [/p][/*][*][p]And most importantly... the FPS-killer mystery is solved!  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]We’re Officially in Early Access (Now For Real)![/b] [/p][p]Some of you noticed the Early Access disclaimer was missing from the Steam page when we launched. The issue has been solved! We are now proud bearers of the Early Access banner on the Steam page thanks to the kind folks at Steam. Thanks for your patience while we sorted that out!  [/p][p][/p][p][b]The Big Performance Patch: Let Us Tell You a Story[/b] [/p][p]So... we found the source of the FPS drops. And it’s both hilarious and horrifying.  [/p][p][/p][p]Imagine this:  [/p][p]You go through 10 rooms. That’s about 10 weapon chests. Plus enemy drops. Let’s say... 45 weapons have spawned so far. Cool.  [/p][p]Now you get a 5-kill streak and go “on fire”. Awesome, right?  [/p][p]Well… it turns out ALL 45 weapons were also like "YO, I'M ON FIRE TOO" 🔥🔥🔥  [/p][p]That’s right. Every weapon you ever saw up was still technically hanging out, and they ALL wanted in on the visual effects party. 45 weapons running fire VFX = instant performance death.  [/p][p]We fixed it! The new patch makes sure only the relevant weapon does its little fire dance. The rest? They’ve been told to sit down and chill.  [/p][p][/p][p]This fix has led to major FPS improvements, especially in longer runs and on mid-range hardware. Even more FPS improvements have also been noted and will be sent out with upcoming patches! We hope you feel the difference immediately and please let us know how it runs for you!   [/p][p][/p][p][b]Aaand Some Hotfix Notes from Yesterday[/b] [/p][list][*][p]We also pushed a quick hotfix that addressed:  [/p][/*][*][p]Collision issues in a few rooms [/p][/*][*][p]Crashes during realm transitions [/p][/*][*][p]Fire rate bugs on certain weapons Localization not loading properly in some languages [/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial panel not pausing the game correctly  [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who reported these. Your feedback is making the game better every day! ❤️[/p]

notes.title: Change Log v1.0.04 (Hot Fix)
notes.content:
🛠️ Hotfix Update – Smooth Transition to Greed!

Hey everyone! Quick update from Hell’s maintenance crew:

We’ve fixed a bug that caused issues when moving from the second theme (Lust) to the third theme (Greed). The path to gold and chaos is now clear, and the run should continue as intended.

Thanks for your patience and for helping us squash these infernal bugs. More updates (and chaos) coming soon!

notes.title: Change Log v1.0.03
notes.content:
Hello!
We just pushed out a quick update to smooth out some rough edges:

[list]
[*] FPS drops have been tackled – the game should now run more smoothly.
[*] General bug fixes – including those annoying moments where you’d fall out of the map and question your life choices.
[/list]

Thanks for playing and keep the feedback coming! We are actively working on fixing bugs ❤️

notes.title: Holy Shoot’s Demo Got an Upgrade—Come Break It Again!
notes.content:
What’s up, Sanctum recruits?

First off—huge thanks for wishlisting Holy Shoot! Seriously, you’re awesome. But guess what? We just dropped a fresh new demo update, and it’s packed with improvements!

Here’s what’s new:
✔ Brand-new UI design & HUD (No more “UI pain,” we promise.)
✔ A brand-new companion (It’s cute. It’s helpful. It’s definitely not annoying… probably.)
✔ Bonus objectives & rewards (Because who doesn’t love extra loot?)
✔ Environmental interactions (Yes, you can now use your surroundings—strategically or chaotically.)
✔ Elemental perks (Pick your flavor of destruction.)
✔ The first two rows of the upgrade tree are now unlocked! (A taste of power… and a tease of what’s to come.)
✔ New weapons (Because sometimes more pewpew is the answer.)
✔ A smoother leveling system (Less grind, more glory.)
✔ Smoother gameplay & general polish (Like a fine wine—aged to chaotic perfection.)
✔ A fresh new OST (Your demon-slaying sessions now come with extra bangers.)

…And more!

We fixed things. We broke things. We fixed them again. Now it’s your turn to put it to the test! Play the updated demo, let us know what you think—and don’t forget to drag your friends into the chaos too!
